notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: a direct Driver over instrumation.drivers.rigol:RigolDS1054Z instead of the ScpiDriver family, because the upstream assembles every channel command from parts (:CHANnel{channel}:DISPLAY, :CHANnel{channel}:SCALe, ... rigol.py:163-176), which a command table cannot reproduce without changing the wire syntax. The driver exposes the scalar settings and control of the DS1054Z: reads of identity, acquire type, sample rate, timebase mode/scale/offset, trigger mode/sweep/status/source/slope/level and channel 1 display/coupling/scale/offset/probe/bandwidth/invert; writes of acquire type, timebase scale, trigger sweep/source/slope/level and channel 1 display/coupling/scale/bandwidth; and x-cap actions run, force_trigger and a safe-state stop. NOT COVERED: the waveform array (get_waveform/get_waveform_raw), the screenshot, the per-channel measurement helpers, acquisition averages and memory depth, the timebase offset, the channel 1 offset/probe ratio/inversion, and channels 2-4. The fake backend is a stateful stand-in using only the upstream method names; its scalar values are placeholders, not a recording, and no hardware run was made. The stop path is the native :STOP method, used by the @estop and by the safe-state action; the card floor is R1, so no independent hardware e-stop is claimed or required. All Facts and sourced Limits cite lines of the clone at the pinned commit; the remaining numeric bounds are Limit.operator_required and site-limits.example.json shows a narrow-only example.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. The DEVIATION FROM THE CARD is accepted: a registry override now makes the card a direct driver. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required: the licence is AGPL-3.0); the package may not be published before it. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
